provenance.why_this_signal: The one component of the MTF basket that survived the market-neutral BTC-beta hedge; decomposition showed its edge is carried entirely by the LONG book.
provenance.in_sample_full: n=391, PF 1.573, exp +1.942R, totalR +759, single-path DD -87.5R, MAR 8.67, 6/7 years positive
provenance.fraction_note: 0.0034 = REFERENCE sizing only, for R/performance tracking (maps the -87.5R in-sample DD to ~30% equity). This is a signal-only paper bot; NO order is ever placed and this fraction is NOT execution sizing.
provenance.max_drawdown_p95_note: 0.30 = the in-sample single-path DD (-87.5R) at the reference f=0.0034 as an equity fraction; NOT a re-derived Monte-Carlo p95.
provenance.nonoverlap_note: The stateless per-candle watch emits every qualifying bar; the registered cell applies 2-day non-overlap spacing. Authoritative REAFFIRM/DOWNGRADE resolution re-runs tools/mtf_long_only.py over the forward window (entries>=1782000000000), which applies the frozen non-overlap + exit + cost.
provenance.downgrade_rule: Post-hoc side filter, resolved forward at n>=40 LONG trades AND >=6 months. REAFFIRM iff forward LONG PF>=1.20 AND expectancy_r>0 AND total_r>0; DOWNGRADE (close lineage, no rescue) otherwise. Stricter PF bar (1.20 vs 1.10 for pre-registered L/S cells) guards the selection. Frozen 2026-07-01, no post-hoc tuning.
provenance.not_all_weather_note: LONG-only was NEGATIVE in the severe 2022 bear (-33.6R while BTC -64%; the short book was that year's hero). It carries partial long beta; a full-cycle bear can overwhelm the timing edge.
provenance.economic_bar: clears 4/5 ECON gates in-sample (PF 1.57 / exp 1.94R / MAR 8.67 / robust 0.857); only the 30R fixed-f DD cap fails (sizing convention). No academic (DSR) gate cleared. PAPER ONLY.
